fleeting_plugin_googlecloud.note: gitlab-org/fleeting/plugins/googlecompute returns 404 Project Not Found; the official name is googlecloud
fleeting_plugin_googlecloud.backend: zonal or regional managed instance group (stateless), autoscaling config deleted, min instances 0, failure action 'No action' recommended
fleeting_plugin_googlecloud.spot_note: preempted spot instances are removed (not restarted) when failure action is 'No action'; instances with local SSD cannot be suspended

gitlab_hosted_gpu_runner.image_policy: bring your own image with GPU driver/CUDA (example nvcr.io/nvidia/cuda:12.1.1-base-ubuntu22.04)
gitlab_hosted_gpu_runner.cloud_provider_on_page: not stated on the GPU page (GCP not verified there)
gitlab_hosted_gpu_runner.extra_minutes_price: $10 per 1,000 minutes, one time payment, valid 12 months
